title: ChartEvo: Self-Evolving Agent Harnesses for Long-Tail Chart Reasoning
title_zh: ChartEvo：自我进化的智能体工具框架用于长尾图表推理

paragraphs.en: 总结：ChartEvo是一个自进化智能体框架，通过共同进化技能与工具，显著提升多模态大模型对长尾图表的推理准确率。 Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have substantially advanced chart understanding and reasoning, yet their performance remains highly uneven across chart types. While modern MLLMs perform well on common charts, their accuracy drops sharply on long-tail charts with diverse visual structures and reasoning requirements. Tool-augmented agents can improve complex chart reasoning by introducing specialized visual capabilities, but manually engineering strategies and tools for the heterogeneous and evolving long tail is difficult to scale. We introduce \textbf{ChartEvo}, a recursive self-improvement framework that enables chart agents to adapt to underperforming chart types through experience-driven harness-level self-improvement. ChartEvo jointly evolves reusable chart-specific Skills and executable Tools, while learning reusable local tool-call chains to compose evolved capabilities and control the inference overhead of tool-augmented reasoning. On long-tail charts from ChartBench and ChartX, ChartEvo improves accuracy over its base MLLM, Qwen3.7-Plus, by \textbf{45.6\%} and \textbf{32.5\%}, respectively, demonstrating the effectiveness of recursive self-improvement for long-tail chart adaptation.
paragraphs.zh: 总结：ChartEvo是一个自进化智能体框架，通过共同进化技能与工具，显著提升多模态大模型对长尾图表的推理准确率。多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在图表理解与推理方面已取得长足进展，但其在不同图表类型上的表现仍高度不均衡。 尽管现代多模态大语言模型在常见图表上表现良好，但在视觉结构和推理需求各异的长尾图表上，其准确率急剧下降。 工具增强的智能体可以通过引入专门的视觉能力来改进复杂图表推理，但针对异质且不断演进的长尾需求人工设计策略与工具难以扩展。 我们提出 \textbf{ChartEvo}，一个递归自我改进框架，使图表智能体能够通过经验驱动的框架层（harness-level）自我改进，适配表现不佳的图表类型。 ChartEvo 共同进化可复用的图表专用技能（Skills）与可执行工具（Tools），同时学习可复用的局部工具调用链，以组合已进化的能力并控制工具增强推理的推理开销。 在来自 ChartBench 和 ChartX 的长尾图表上，ChartEvo 相对于其基座多模态大语言模型 Qwen3.7-Plus 分别将准确率提升了 \textbf{45.6\%} 和 \textbf{32.5\%}，证明了递归自我改进在长尾图表适配上的有效性。
